entities.summary: Nikita Andreyevich Tryamkin is a Russian professional ice hockey defenceman for the Avtomobilist Yekaterinburg of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Tryamkin made his KHL debut playing with Avtomobilist Yekaterinburg during the 2012–13 KHL season. He was selected by the Vancouver Canucks of the National Hockey League (NHL) in the 2014 NHL entry draft and briefly played with the team.
